BNKA.name: Bank Prepaid Account
BNKA.definition: Prepaid account managed by a financial institution for low income customers.

CPYA.name: Company Prepaid Account
CPYA.definition: Specific prepaid account for companies or professionals expenses.

ELMY.name: Electronic Money Account
ELMY.definition: Account supporting e-money issued by an electronic money issuer.

GIFT.name: Gift Card
GIFT.definition: Payment mean issued by retailers or banks as a substitute to a non-monetary gift. Usually, this Stored Value item is used only once.

GCER.name: Gift Certificate
GCER.definition: Certificate to be given to a customer. Usually one shot voucher.

MLVC.name: Meal Voucher
MLVC.definition: Meal and check voucher for restaurants.

OLVC.name: Online Voucher
OLVC.definition: Voucher that can be used online once or in several times.

MERC.name: Merchant Account
MERC.definition: Prepaid account open with a merchant or big retailers.

OTHR.name: Other Prepaid Account
OTHR.definition: Other non listed stored value instrument.

PHON.name: Phone Card
PHON.definition: Stored value instrument used to pay telephone services (e.g. card or identifier).

CARD.name: Smart Card Tag
CARD.definition: Stored value account hold on the chip of a smart card.
